Game Overview

In Jump on Jupiter, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a brave astronaut through outer space in Jump on Jupiter. Master the art of timing with intuitive tap controls to adjust his flight path. Earn points with thrilling near misses and successful portal entries, all set against a captivating cosmic atmosphere.
